name: Exosystem
detailed_description:
Hack yourself, hack your friends, hack your enemies and hack EVERYTHING in this twin-stick, action immersive-sim. Use OVERPOWERED hacks that no other game would let you use to overcome intelligent enemies in a plagued simulation.

You (and your potential friends?) will need to use game-breaking hacks in order to beat twelve-y/o mastermind Exo at his own game. Just, try not to kill your teammates too much.

Unique Hacking System!

Hacking is done through typing different binary codes in a command console. Hacks can be:

  • as USEFUL as turning a target invisible,

  • as DEADLY as firing all of a target's ammo at once,

  • or as GAME-BREAKING as taking complete control over a target! (Don't throw your teammates off cliffs).

Hacks can be as useful on yourself as an enemy, some of them riskier than others!

All hacks are blocked only by your knowledge of the codes, your reflexes to use them during combat, and your creativity to decide which hacks to use and on who. (You can hack anything!)

Intelligent Oppressors!

Your enemies, the Bugbots, will be as numerous as they are capable. Your enemies have access to all of the same tools you do, but with hacking they become tools themselves.

Other enemy factions will also impede your escape, making for full-scale battles across varied battlegrounds.

Yes, I said 'Immersive-Sim'

That means escape the Exosystem your way!

  • Maybe you'll pick your favorite character and focus on playing to their unique strengths

  • Maybe you'll sneak by enemies, using teleportation and invisibility to your benefit

  • Maybe you'll make an army of allies and clones to defeat every problem with numbers

  • Maybe you'll pit enemies against each other, without ever being seen yourself

  • Maybe you'll use the environment and physics to defeat targets or parkour past them

  • Maybe you'll speedrun through the entire game using hacks which make you faster

  • Maybe you'll spend hours and hours discovering all the hacks, finding the perfect hack in every situation...

You're still reading?

GO AHEAD AND WISHLIST IT NOW!!!!!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: i3-530 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 425M
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: i7-530 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 870M or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
